biography:
== Biography ==
Catherine McElaney (also McLaney) was born in East Cambridge, Massachusetts, about 1828, the daughter of Thomas and Susan McElaney, both born in Ireland.<ref name="cathdeath">"Massachusetts, State Vital Records, 1638-1927", database, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:N7RS-674 : accessed 18 November 2026), Catharine McElaney Mullen, died 1872 (13 Oct 1872 per the town record, https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:FHGK-ZKH), Boston; age 44, born E. Cambridge; married, spouse James; parents Thomas and Susan, both born Ireland; vol. 249 p. 207.</ref> She probably married James Mullin (Mullen) at Sandwich on 24 August 1851.<ref name="marr1851">"Massachusetts, Town Clerk, Vital and Town Records, 1626-2001", database, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:Q29L-JNBG : accessed 18 November 2026), James Mullin and Catherine McLaney, married 24 Aug 1851, Sandwich, Barnstable, Massachusetts; p. 36.</ref> Their daughter Susan T. Mullen was born in Cambridge on 24 August 1857; the birth register gives the mother's birthplace as Cambridge.<ref name="susanbirth">"Massachusetts, State Vital Records, 1638-1927", database with images, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:FXCL-6C3 : accessed 18 November 2026), Susan T. Mullen, born 24 Aug 1857, Cambridge, Middlesex; Cambridge births 1857, p. 77, no. 335 (film 004341179, image 922). Parents James and Catherine Mullen; father a coffin maker, born Charlestown; mother born Cambridge.</ref>

Catherine died in Boston on 13 October 1872, aged 44, and was buried at Mount Calvary Cemetery, Roslindale.<ref name="cathdeath" /><ref name="cathgrave">"Find a Grave Index", database, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:66M9-RX3Y : accessed 18 November 2026), Catherine McLaney Mullen, 1828 - 12 Oct 1872, burial Mount Calvary Cemetery, Roslindale, Boston.</ref>

=== Research Notes ===
* Her parents Thomas and Susan McElaney (both born in Ireland) are not yet researched.
